description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, targeting Thought Reflection.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Fractured Identity.
Resolve each opponent's Fractured Identity.
Resolve your Fractured Identity, exiling Thought Reflection and causing each opponent to create a copy of it.
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Enter the Infinite.
Resolve the first opponent's Enter the Infinite, causing the opponent to draw cards equal to twice their deck size, and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
Repeat step 7 for each other opponent.
